served: Trivia Four Horsemen Trivia The Four Horsemen are based, in name and concept, on the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse Japanese: 黙示録の四騎士 Mokushiroku no Yonkishi from Christian eschatology, appearing in John's Book of Revelation (6:1–8) of the New Testament. Per some interpretations, they are thought to be referenced in the Old Testament's prophetic Book of Zechariah and in Ezekiel. Overview Four Horsemen Overview The Horsemen are four particularly powerful Devils who take on the form of human females and consider themselves "sisters" 姉妹 shimai.(Chapter 108)(Chapter 113)(Chapter 118)(Chapter 131)(Chapter 135)(Chapter 146) Death is the eldest and most powerful,(Chapter 146) Fami (Famine) is the second-eldest,(Chapter 108) and Yoru (War) along with Nayuta (Control) are the youngest. While Nayuta is currently the youngest of the four as Makima's recently born reincarnation,(Chapter 97) it is not explicitly confirmed if Fami and Yoru are older than Makima was. Together, the sisters are presumably known to have engaged in a particularly brutal battle in Hell against the Devil most feared by other Devils: "Chainsaw Man".(Chapter 87)(Chapter 98)(Chapter 99)(Chapter 104)(Chapter 135) The Horsemen seem to be the only entities in the world (Devil or otherwise) who still remember the names of the Devils devoured by Chainsaw Man, such as the Nuclear Weapons Devil, the World War II Devil, the Nazi Devil, and others. However, it is unclear how far these memories go: Makima, the Control Devil's previous incarnation, could remember the names of devoured Devils but admitted that she could not recall them beyond the sight of them fighting Chainsaw, and that even those memories were starting to fade;(Chapter 84)(Chapter 98) the next incarnation, Nayuta, appears to bear no memories from her predecessor's life. Katana Man (real name unknown), known officially as Samurai Sword サムライソード Samurai Sōdo, is a Devil-human Hybrid who merged with the Katana Devil 刀の悪魔 Katana no Akuma. His grandfather was the Debt Collector killed by Denji and because of that, he teamed up with Akane to get revenge on Denji and steal his heart. subject: Makima
q: What happened to Makima during the Katana Man arc, in order?
served: Summary Episode 9 Summary Katana Man tells Akane that he won't be able to fight for a while. Some of his comrades are carrying Denji. One of them sees a crow and then starts saying something feels strange. As they wonder what he means, the man is the crushed to death. Akane immediately calls Team E and asks that Team C reconfirm that Makima is dead. The Team E member tells her that he is unable to contact Team C for a while and in that moment, he also ends up being crushed to death. At the shrine, Makima has Michiko, Yutaro and the convicts with blindfolds. Yutaro wonders why they need blindfolds and Michiko states that Makima reports directly to the Chief Cabinet Secretary, and ordinary devil hunters aren't authorized to know which devils she has contracts with. Makima walks to one of the convicts and tells him to repeat the name "Shuzo Mishima." As the convict repeats the name, Makima makes hand signs. Katana Man tells his comrade, Mishima, to get Denji in the car, however as Makima finishes her hand signs, Mishima gets crushed to death, and the convict also dies. Makima then moves to another convict asking him to say "Takashi Inoue." The man repeats it and Makima crushes to death another comrade of Katana Man. The rest of Katana Man's comrades panic and start running, but Makima kills them one by one. She leaves Katana Man and Akane alive and tells Michiko and Yutaro to remove their blindfolds. As they do, they see all the convicts are dead. Makima explains that she did what she can from here and is now returning to Tokyo. Abilities Makima Abilities As a Devil, Makima possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. These include the ability to make contracts with humans. Thanks to her ability to control humans, she is also able to force them to make a contract with herself. Makima made a contract with the Prime Minister of Japan in return for working for the Japanese government. As a result of this contract, any fatal attacks inflicted to Makima are transferred into an appropriate illness or accident affecting a random citizen of Japan. She was shown to have been shot in the back of the head and seemingly killed, only to stand up later with no visible wounds. She stated that she was merely grazed by the bullet, but this is unlikely given the placement of the gun when it was fired, as well as the location of the blood from the exit wound. Later, she was killed by the Gun Devil after it fired a bullet through her head, though it did not finish her off. It is confirmed that she had been killed twenty-six times up until the attack of the Gun Devil. Later on, she gets killed by Pochita several times during their final confrontation.
